crossRefs.note: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice…
The first creature was like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face like a man…

translations.web: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”
translations.bsb: And when the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”
translations.kjv: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
translations.asv: And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, Come.
